scheme_name: Grant of Stipends to the Physically Handicapped Students
other_conditions: Must be a regular student of a recognized school
Must not be a repeater in the current standard (one failure may be condoned at the Director's discretion)
Must not be residing in or receiving maintenance from any government institutions, local bodies, or grant‑receiving private organizations
Must not be receiving any other stipend or scholarship
Multiple physically handicapped children from the same family are eligible if other conditions are met
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹200 for standards 1‑8 and ₹300 for standards 9‑12, payable for 11 months in two installments.
